title: content.box_assets 1.0
description: content::BoxAssets: stock-named resources only one box's sessions load. Either a textures folder (one .dds or .png per stock texture, at the path of the stock resource below root, packed by the core) or a ready archive of the addon. The archive is listed first in the asset groups of the box's cars (every car, or one team entry's), so a session of any other box never loads it. The game keeps the first copy of a resource name it loads, so a resource shows only where the box's cars load before the stock archive that holds the same name.

kind.description: What the resources dress; it picks the default root and is named in the core's log. garage: garage and pit lane art; sponsors: trackside sponsor boards; marshals: track marshal kit; crowd: the crowd; principal: team principal clothing; scene: stock scene groups (the grid cutscene, a garage scene) named in groups; other: anything else.

entry.description: The key of one team entry of the package: only that entry's cars list the archive. Empty or left out: every car of the box.

textures.description: A folder in the addon holding .dds and .png files. A file at a/b_d.dds is the resource root + a/b_d.tif.image and its view root + a/b_d.tif. One of textures and archive.

root.description: The resource name every textures file path is appended to. Empty or left out: the stock root of the kind (garage: eaid://environment_package/core_assets/objects/textures/, sponsors: eaid://environment_package/core_assets/shared_textures/sponsors/), else eaid:// itself, so the folder mirrors the whole resource name.

srgb.description: A .png file is encoded as sRGB BC7 when true, linear BC7 when false. A .dds file keeps its own format.

archive.description: A ready .erp archive in the addon, listed as it is (any resource types, e.g. texture arrays or material bindings). It needs resources. One of textures and archive.

groups.description: Kind scene only: the stock scene asset groups (names ending in .assetgroup, e.g. asset_groups/animation_package/scenes/cinematics/cinematicsgrid.assetgroup) that read the archive first while the package's box is the session's box (a box press or a career season of the box); every other session reads their stock list. Needs an archive and the package's entrant_list.

resources.description: The eaid:// name prefixes the archive (or the packed textures) may hold; the core refuses the record when a resource name starts with none of them.

extends.description: Data files only: this record is a variant of that record, and its value is a merge patch on the base.

path.description: A file or folder in the addon's folder, with / between folders. null: empty.
